name: The Lippincott Team
intro: Led by broker and team lead Amy Lippincott, the team handles buying, selling, leasing and relocation across Cypress and Northwest Houston, with a 16-person roster split into buyer specialists, listing specialists, relocation specialists, marketing and transaction coordination. Amy’s HAR record shows 511 homes sold and 159 leases, and recent clients in 2026 highlight fast responses and smooth closings, including in Bridgeland.
short: Our #1 choice. Led by Amy Lippincott. A 16-person team for buying, selling, leasing and relocation in Cypress communities such as Bridgeland, Towne Lake, Coles Crossing and Fairfield.

facts.text: The team works across Cypress communities including Bridgeland, Coles Crossing, Fairfield Village and Towne Lake, plus Tomball, Katy, Magnolia, Waller and Hockley, covering Cy-Fair, Katy, Tomball and Waller ISDs.

Sixteen people are on the roster: Amy Lippincott as broker and team lead, a director of buyer operations, buyer specialists, listing specialists (two also handle relocation), a marketing director and a transaction coordinator.

Sellers get a comparative market analysis, staging guidance, professional photography and online marketing. Relocating buyers get neighborhood, school and commute comparisons, according to the team website.
Amy Lippincott’s HAR record shows 511 homes sold and 159 leases. Recent sales range from about $285K to $947K, and active listings run from about $435K to $1.6M.
The team also handles rentals: HAR shows leases from about $3,000 to $10,000 a month and several current rental listings.
Amy is a native Houstonian who taught for 16 years before moving into real estate, according to her HAR biography.

Individual HAR surveys for Amy Lippincott dated June through August 2026 (not a team-wide score) praise responsiveness, market knowledge and smooth transactions. A July 2026 client described a fast rental in the Bridgeland area.
The team reports nine Houston Business Journal Residential Real Estate awards from 2017 through 2025 (self-reported).

name: Kevan Pewitt
intro: Kevan Pewitt has been a licensed Texas broker since 1989 and founded Houston Prime Realty in 1995. He is also a Texas Certified Residential Appraiser, and says he prices listings with an appraiser’s discipline. Clients work with him directly. His 2026 guides cover Cypress communities such as Bridgeland, Towne Lake and Coles Crossing, and October 2026 HAR reviews call him thorough and knowledgeable.
short: Broker since 1989 and a certified residential appraiser. Hands-on service for buyers, sellers and renters in Cypress, Katy and Hockley.

facts.text: He has been a licensed Texas real estate broker since 1989 and founded Houston Prime Realty, an independent brokerage, in 1995.
He is also a Texas Certified Residential Appraiser and says he prices listings using an appraiser’s valuation methods.
He holds the Certified Residential Specialist (CRS) designation and the Texas Affordable Housing Specialist (TAHS) designation, which covers affordable-housing and down-payment programs.

HAR lists first-time buyers, relocation and new construction among his buyer services. His record shows 49 homes sold and 26 leases, with recent buyer-side sales in Katy, Hockley and Houston, mostly between $250K and $370K.

His 2026 Cypress guide covers communities including Bridgeland, Towne Lake, Cypress Creek Lakes, Coles Crossing and Fairfield, and explains how property taxes and municipal utility districts affect costs.

Listings get a comparative market analysis, professional photography (with drone or twilight shots where suitable), walkthrough video or floor plans, HAR MLS syndication, targeted social media and outreach to agents with matching buyers.
His seller guide says commission is negotiated and put in writing, and that any contribution toward the buyer’s agent fee is the seller’s choice.
In October 2026 HAR comments, a Hockley buyer said he took notes on every area and house and worked to get a good deal. A seller called him professional and a pleasure to work with.
He reports being named a Texas Monthly Five Star Professional Real Estate Agent for 11 years (self-reported).

name: Michele Harmon
intro: Michele Harmon leads the Michele Harmon Team at RE/MAX Universal, with an office on Spring Cypress Road. The team has served clients since 2012, and her HAR record shows 469 homes sold and 24 leases. Her recent work in Cypress covers both buyers and sellers, from about $400K homes to a sale above $1.2M in October 2026.
short: Certified Negotiation Expert leading a Cypress-based RE/MAX team since 2012. 469 homes sold on HAR, with recent Cypress sales on both buyer and seller sides.

facts.text: She leads the Michele Harmon Team at RE/MAX Universal, with an office on Spring Cypress Road in Cypress. The team has served clients since 2012 and reports helping over 1,000 buyers and sellers and closing over $500 million in sales (self-reported).
She serves Cypress, Tomball, Magnolia, Spring, The Woodlands and Northwest Houston.
HAR shows 469 homes sold and 24 leases, plus 23 active listings in October 2026, mostly between about $320K and $599K in Tomball and Cypress.
She represents both sides: in October 2026 she sold a Cypress home for a seller on Val Verde Springs Court and represented a buyer on a Cypress home in the $1.24M–$1.43M range.
Her Cypress sales from June to August 2026 ranged from about $398K to $860K in list price, alongside sales in Tomball, Spring, Hockley and Houston.
She holds the Certified Negotiation Expert (CNE) designation, which covers negotiation training for real estate transactions.
Sellers can request a free home-selling analysis and comparative market analysis through her HAR profile.
As of October 14, 2026, HAR displayed 293 Google reviews for her with a 5-star average. These are Google reviews, not HAR surveys, and individual dated comments were not shown.

name: Jill Smith
intro: Jill Smith has more than 17 years in real estate and lives in Copper Lakes. She leads an 11-agent team with dedicated listing, transaction and marketing coordinators. The team covers more than two dozen Cypress communities and offers new-construction searches, a Buy Before You Sell program and help with pre-listing repairs. Her October 2026 pricing guide explains how new builds in Bridgeland, Towne Lake and Elyson compete with resale homes.
short: 17+ years in Cypress real estate, CRS and luxury-marketing credentials. An 11-agent team with Buy Before You Sell, new-construction searches and subdivision-level pricing.

facts.text: She has more than 17 years of real estate experience and lives in Copper Lakes in Cypress, according to her HAR biography.
She leads a team of 11 agents, with separate listing, transaction and marketing coordinators who manage the file from listing through closing.
Her credentials include CRS, GRI, ABR, MCNE (Master Certified Negotiation Expert) and CLHMS (Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist), and HAR lists her in the eXp Luxury Division.
HAR shows 539 homes sold and 59 rentals, with active listings from about $295K to $750K in October 2026.

The team’s communities include Bridgeland, Towne Lake, Fairfield, Coles Crossing, Copperfield, Copper Lakes, Blackhorse Ranch, Elyson, Riata Ranch and Stone Gate, plus Katy, Tomball and Jersey Village.

Services include new-construction home searches, a Buy Before You Sell program with HomeLight, cash offers, help with pre-listing repairs, and searches for gated, golf-course, large-lot and pool homes.

Her October 6, 2026 guide advises pricing against recent closed sales in the same subdivision rather than area averages, and notes that new construction in Bridgeland, Towne Lake and Elyson competes with resale homes.
Her HAR sub-scores include 4.93 for market knowledge and 4.89 for communication. September 2026 comments describe helping a buyer relocate from Ohio and a “very simple and straightforward” sale.

name: Tiffani Reynolds
intro: Tiffani Reynolds has been licensed since 2017, after nine years as a high school band director. She holds buyer-representation, senior real estate, luxury marketing and new-construction credentials, and handles both sales and leasing. Her 2026 HAR reviews come mostly from sellers, who credit accurate pricing advice, quick sales and patient, pressure-free guidance.
short: Licensed since 2017, with senior-move, luxury and new-construction credentials. 2026 sellers praise her pricing advice and quick sales.

facts.text: She has been a real estate agent since 2017. Before that she spent nine years as a high school band director and is a certified principal, according to her HAR profile.

Her designations are ABR (Accredited Buyer Representative), SRES (Seniors Real Estate Specialist), CLHMS (Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist), NHC (New Home Construction) and C2EX (Commitment to Excellence).
HAR shows 151 homes sold and 81 leases. Recent sales range from about $250K to $370K and recent leases from about $2,000 to $4,000 a month.
Her HAR profile lists a Keller Williams Signature office in Katy and activity across the Houston area, so ask for recent Cypress examples.
Sellers reviewing her in April 2026 said her pricing guidance was accurate, her advice on preparing the home was practical, and their homes sold quickly.

A relocating buyer in June 2026 praised her area knowledge, responsiveness and follow-up, and another buyer that month said she handled all the details, including getting a plumber to confirm a repair.
A July 2026 seller moving to senior living said she was patient and thorough and helped resolve issues with the buyers. A September 2026 seller praised her efficiency and communication.
She works with repeat clients: a May 2026 review came from a buyer working with her for the third time.

name: Collette King
intro: Collette King has more than 27 years in real estate, and her team has served Northwest Houston since 1997. She leads a four-person RE/MAX Universal team. Most of her 2026 sales are listings, with Cypress (77429 and 77433) her most common market. She also handles a steady flow of rentals, with 19 leases recorded in 2026.
short: 27+ years in real estate, with a seller-heavy 2026 record centered on Cypress and active leasing. RE/MAX Diamond Award 2019–2025.

facts.text: She has more than 27 years of experience representing buyers and sellers, and her team has served the Northwest Houston area since 1997 (self-reported).
HAR shows 14 closed sales between April 14 and July 31, 2026. Eleven were listings she represented for the seller, with list prices from about $189,000 to $699,000.
Cypress (77429 and 77433) is the most common location in her recent sales, followed by Tomball, Spring, Northwest Houston and Conroe.
She handles rentals as well: HAR records 19 leases in 2026, most recently in Cypress on October 1, with asking rents across her leases from $1,275 to $6,500 a month.
She leads a four-person team at RE/MAX Universal: Collette King, Rocio Ovalle, Clay Holloway and Vincent Discon.
Sellers get a valuation based on comparable nearby homes, advice on which repairs to make before listing, and marketing through the RE/MAX network, according to the team website.
The team serves Cypress, Tomball, Spring, Katy, Fulshear, Richmond, Conroe, Magnolia, Montgomery, The Woodlands and Waller, and works with new construction (self-reported).
Her HAR profile lists the RE/MAX Hall of Fame, RE/MAX Diamond Award for 2019–2025 and Top 500 RE/MAX Agents of Texas for 2018–2025.
A seller surveyed on HAR on July 27, 2026 described Collette as extremely helpful and responsive.

name: Christine O’Brien
intro: Christine O’Brien has been licensed since 2022 and focuses on first-time buyers, new construction and relocation. On new builds she represents the buyer rather than the builder, and she runs remote purchases for out-of-state transferees with live video tours. Her Cypress sales include Bridgeland, Fairfield, Villages of Cypress Lakes and Cypress Creek Lakes, mostly between about $285K and $552K.
short: First-time buyers, new construction and remote relocation. Recent Cypress sales in Bridgeland, Fairfield and Villages of Cypress Lakes.

facts.text: She focuses on first-time buyers, new construction and relocation. On new builds she represents the buyer rather than the builder, and she offers virtual tours and school-district breakdowns for movers.
She serves Cypress, Conroe, The Woodlands and Magnolia and has been licensed since 2022, according to her website.
Her April 2026 first-time buyer guide walks Cypress and Conroe buyers through budgeting, closing costs and each step of the purchase.
For out-of-state and corporate-transfer buyers she runs a remote process: pre-approval, live FaceTime or Zoom tours, and coordination with builder sales teams.
Her May 2026 Dunham Pointe guide covers the community south of US-290 at Mason Road, with five active builders and homes from the $400s to just over $1 million, and notes that taxes vary by section.

Her Cypress sales on HAR include homes in Bridgeland (Lakeland Heights), Fairfield (Inwood Park), Villages of Cypress Lakes, Cypress Creek Lakes, Park Creek and Miramesa, mostly in the $285K–$552K price bands.
HAR’s sales list from January 2023 to September 2026 spans Cypress, Katy, Tomball, Spring, Conroe, The Woodlands and Magnolia.
Her HAR profile shows 65 homes sold and 5 rentals, but no client recommendations or survey rating yet.

name: Cy-Fair Real Estate
intro: Cy-Fair Real Estate is a small independent brokerage based in Cypress (77433), led by broker and owner Jim Mulholland. HAR credits the firm with 271 homes sold and 107 leases, and lists English- and Spanish-speaking agents. Jim’s individual HAR rating is 4.95 from 72 surveys, and June 2026 clients praised his grasp of market trends.
short: Independent Cypress brokerage led by broker-owner Jim Mulholland. 271 homes sold and 107 leases on HAR, with English- and Spanish-speaking agents.

facts.text: The brokerage office is at 18810 Ellis Bend Drive in Cypress (77433). Jim Mulholland is its broker of record. HAR lists six agents and notes that its agents speak English and Spanish.
HAR credits the brokerage with 271 homes sold and 107 leases. In October 2026 it had seven active listings averaging about $476K, and its sold homes averaged about $171 per square foot.

Recent brokerage sales on HAR include Cypress homes in the 77433 and 77429 ZIP codes in roughly the $480K to $720K range, and Spring homes around $325K to $370K. Recent leases in 77433 were about $2,000 to $3,000 a month.

Jim Mulholland’s own HAR record shows sales from May 2022 through August 2026, from a $85K Hockley lot to Cypress homes listed around $1.25M, with recent closings in Cypress and Spring in August 2026.
Before real estate, Jim earned an engineering degree from Texas A&M and spent more than 15 years in the computer industry, according to his HAR biography.

The firm’s website says it serves Cypress, Hockley and Northwest Houston, and has served Cypress for over 15 years (self-reported). Sellers can request a free market analysis, and buyers can set up a personalized home search.
Its website blog had new posts in October 2026, including a guide to Bridgeland’s Lakeland Village in August 2026.
In June 2026 HAR comments, a seller on Paddlefish Way said Jim had sold two of their homes and praised his attention to market trends. A buyer called him “the greatest.”
